summary: The T069 acceptance clause 'one manifest per member pool under one run identity' is ambiguous between two product behaviours, and the implementation only matches one of them. RunRequest declares a single pool_key_id and submit publishes one manifest per request (reading b: each pool under its own run_id, sharing dataset/numeraire/qualification). Reading (a) — a single RunRequest names multiple pools and the orchestrator publishes one manifest per pool under one run_id — is not implemented and would require a RunRequest schema change plus multi-pool orchestration. The deliverables' singular 'the pool and block range' phrasing is consistent with reading (b); the only place 'member pool(s)' and 'one run identity' meet is the acceptance clause. All other checks pass (38 T069 tests green, 2685 broader suite green, no must-not violations). The previous review (146df50) recorded this under Unknowns; review-002 escalates it to TRIAGE_REQUIRED because the contract owner has not resolved the ambiguity. The choice changes product intent, so the Owner must pick the reading.
